keywords: Action Verbs, Resume Tailoring, Mindset Shift

question.t: 針對 Taskify AI 的「軟體工程專家 (Software Engineering Specialist)」職缺，其核心任務為 RLHF 與代碼評測。
question.en: For the 'Software Engineering Specialist' role at Taskify AI, the core mission is RLHF and code evaluation.

question.t: 為了將你的履歷從「建造者 (Builder)」轉型為「審查者 (Reviewer)」，以下哪一組動詞最適合用來替換原本的 "Built", "Designed", "Implemented"？
question.en: To shift your resume persona from 'Builder' to 'Reviewer', which set of verbs is most suitable to replace 'Built', 'Designed', and 'Implemented'?

options.t: (A) Managed, Led, Strategized
options.en: (A) Managed, Led, Strategized

options.t: (B) Validated, Audited, Benchmarked
options.en: (B) Validated, Audited, Benchmarked

options.t: (C) Deployed, Configured, Provisioned
options.en: (C) Deployed, Configured, Provisioned

options.t: (D) Programmed, Scripted, Coded
options.en: (D) Programmed, Scripted, Coded

why.t: 此職缺看重的是「找出錯誤」與「評估品質」的能力，而非從零建置系統。(B) 選項中的動詞直接對應 JD 中的 "Review", "Validate", "Benchmark"。(A) 太偏管理，(C) 偏維運，(D) 則過於基礎。
why.en: This role values the ability to 'find errors' and 'evaluate quality' rather than building systems from scratch. The verbs in (B) directly correspond to 'Review', 'Validate', and 'Benchmark' in the JD. (A) is too managerial, (C) is operational, and (D) is too basic.

question.t: 你的原始履歷 Summary 開頭為 "Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience..."。
question.en: Your original resume Summary starts with 'Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience...'.

question.t: 考慮到你擁有 "Google Certified: Generative AI Leader" 證照，且 JD 強調 AI 代碼生成與評測，下列哪一種修改策略最能產生強烈的「第一印象」？
question.en: Considering you hold the 'Google Certified: Generative AI Leader' certification and the JD emphasizes AI code generation and evaluation, which revision strategy creates the strongest 'first impression'?

options.t: (A) 保持原樣，將證照列在履歷最底部的 Certifications 區塊即可，以免喧賓奪主。
options.en: (A) Keep it as is and list the certification at the bottom in the Certifications section to avoid overshadowing your experience.

options.t: (B) 在 Summary 的最後一句補充 "Also holds a Google AI certification."。
options.en: (B) Add 'Also holds a Google AI certification.' as the last sentence of the Summary.

options.t: (C) 將證照頭銜移至 Summary 的第一句開頭，例如 "Google Certified Generative AI Leader & Senior Software Engineer..."，並強調驗證複雜系統的經驗。
options.en: (C) Move the certification title to the very beginning of the Summary, e.g., 'Google Certified Generative AI Leader & Senior Software Engineer...', and highlight experience in validating complex systems.

options.t: (D) 刪除 15 年經驗的描述，改寫為 "AI Enthusiast looking for entry-level AI role" 以展現謙虛。
options.en: (D) Remove the mention of 15 years of experience and rewrite as 'AI Enthusiast looking for entry-level AI role' to show humility.

why.t: 對於此特定職缺，該證照是核心資格 (Essential Qualification) 的強力訊號，而非僅是加分項。將其置於開頭能立即建立「懂 AI 的資深工程師」形象，直接命中 Recruiter 的篩選關鍵字。
why.en: For this specific role, the certification is a strong signal of Essential Qualification, not just a bonus. Placing it at the beginning immediately establishes the persona of an 'AI-savvy Senior Engineer', directly hitting the Recruiter's screening keywords.

keywords: Bullet Points, Experience Tailoring, AI-assisted Development

question.t: 在 Innova Solutions 的經歷中，你原本寫道："Leveraged AI-assisted development and refactoring to reduce review time."。
question.en: In your Innova Solutions experience, you originally wrote: 'Leveraged AI-assisted development and refactoring to reduce review time.'.

question.t: 為了證明你具備 JD 要求的 "Review AI-generated code" 能力，以下哪一種改寫方式最具說服力？
question.en: To demonstrate the 'Review AI-generated code' capability required by the JD, which rewrite is the most persuasive?

options.t: (A) "Used ChatGPT to write code faster, increasing personal productivity by 20%."
options.en: (A) "Used ChatGPT to write code faster, increasing personal productivity by 20%."

options.t: (B) "Validated and reviewed AI-generated code snippets for security protocols and edge cases, ensuring production-grade quality in a GCP environment."
options.en: (B) "Validated and reviewed AI-generated code snippets for security protocols and edge cases, ensuring production-grade quality in a GCP environment."

options.t: (C) "Implemented AI tools in the CI/CD pipeline to automatically deploy code without human intervention."
options.en: (C) "Implemented AI tools in the CI/CD pipeline to automatically deploy code without human intervention."

options.t: (D) "Studied Generative AI principles and passed the Google certification exam."
options.en: (D) "Studied Generative AI principles and passed the Google certification exam."

why.t: 選項 (B) 明確展示了 "Human-in-the-loop" 的審查過程，強調了對安全性與邊界條件的把關，這正是 RLHF/Code Evaluation 工作的核心。(A) 只強調速度，(C) 忽略了審查，(D) 屬於證照而非實戰經驗。
why.en: Option (B) clearly demonstrates the 'Human-in-the-loop' review process, emphasizing the gatekeeping of security and edge cases, which is the core of RLHF/Code Evaluation work. (A) only emphasizes speed, (C) ignores review, and (D) relates to certification rather than hands-on experience.

question.t: JD 要求精通 Python, JavaScript, Java, C++。你的履歷雖然都有列出，但為了展現你對這些語言在「不同場景下的最佳實踐」有深刻理解，應如何優化 Skills 區塊？
question.en: The JD requires proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Java, and C++. Although your resume lists them all, how should you optimize the Skills section to show deep understanding of 'best practices in different contexts'?

options.t: (A) 僅列出語言名稱，並依照字母順序排列：C++, Java, JavaScript, Python。
options.en: (A) List only the language names in alphabetical order: C++, Java, JavaScript, Python.

options.t: (B) 標註用途與場景，例如：Java (Backend Architecture), Python (Data Processing), C++ (System Performance), JS (Frontend Logic)。
options.en: (B) Label with usage and context, e.g., Java (Backend Architecture), Python (Data Processing), C++ (System Performance), JS (Frontend Logic).

options.t: (C) 刪除較少使用的 C++，專注於你最強的 Java，以免面試被問倒。
options.en: (C) Remove C++, which is used less frequently, and focus on your strongest language, Java, to avoid being stumped in the interview.

options.t: (D) 使用進度條圖形 (Progress Bars) 來表示對各語言的熟練度百分比。
options.en: (D) Use progress bars to represent proficiency percentages for each language.

why.t: 對於評測型職缺，面試官希望看到你能在「正確的場景使用正確的工具」。選項 (B) 不僅證明你會寫，還證明你懂架構與應用場景，這暗示了你具備審查跨語言代碼的能力。(D) 的圖表通常不被 ATS 友善且缺乏具體資訊。
why.en: For an evaluation-type role, interviewers want to see that you can 'use the right tool for the right context'. Option (B) proves not only that you can code, but that you understand architecture and application contexts, implying the ability to review cross-language code. (D) charts are generally not ATS-friendly and lack specific information.

question.t: JD 中提到 "Excellent technical writing with attention to implementation detail" 是一項必要資格。除了在 Skills 列出 "Technical Writing" 外，以下哪些方式能更有效地在履歷中證明此能力？（複選）
question.en: The JD mentions 'Excellent technical writing with attention to implementation detail' as an essential qualification. Besides listing 'Technical Writing' in Skills, which of the following methods effectively prove this capability in your resume? (Multiple Choice)

question.t: 請選擇所有正確的策略。
question.en: Please select all correct strategies.

options.t: (A) 在工作經歷中提及 "Authored detailed technical specifications" 或 "Created API documentation"。
options.en: (A) Mention 'Authored detailed technical specifications' or 'Created API documentation' in work experience.

options.t: (B) 強調 "Provided structured feedback to engineering teams"，這顯示了給予清晰回饋的能力。
options.en: (B) Highlight 'Provided structured feedback to engineering teams', which shows the ability to give clear feedback.

options.t: (C) 附上你發表的學術論文連結（如果有的話），即使主題與軟體無關。
options.en: (C) Attach links to your published academic papers (if any), even if the topic is unrelated to software.

options.t: (D) 確保履歷本身的格式、語法與邏輯完美無瑕，因為履歷本身就是寫作能力的展現。
options.en: (D) Ensure the resume's own formatting, grammar, and logic are flawless, as the resume itself is a demonstration of writing skills.

why.t: (A) 與 (B) 直接描述了與 JD 要求相符的寫作行為（規格書、代碼回饋）。(D) 是最直接的證據，一份充滿錯字或邏輯混亂的履歷會直接否定你的寫作能力。(C) 若主題無關，對於軟體工程職缺的加分有限，不如專注於技術文件。
why.en: (A) and (B) directly describe writing behaviors matching the JD requirements (specs, code feedback). (D) is the most direct evidence; a resume full of typos or confused logic will directly negate your writing skills. (C) adds limited value for a software engineering role if the topic is unrelated; focus on technical documentation instead.

question.t: 考慮到你的資歷（15 年以上經驗）與 JD 的性質（代碼評測與 RLHF），你需要避免給人留下「過度資深以至於不願動手」的印象。
question.en: Considering your seniority (15+ years) and the nature of the JD (Code Evaluation & RLHF), you need to avoid giving the impression of being "too senior to be hands-on."

question.t: 以下哪種履歷修改策略最能有效化解這個潛在的偏見？
question.en: Which of the following resume tailoring strategies most effectively mitigates this potential bias?

options.t: (A) 強調你在 Chunghwa Telecom 擔任「資深專案工程師」時的領導經驗，展示你能管理大型團隊。
options.en: (A) Highlight your leadership experience as a "Senior Project Engineer" at Chunghwa Telecom to show you can manage large teams.

options.t: (B) 在工作描述中大量使用 "Debugged"、"Refactored"、"Analyzed" 等動詞，證明你仍活躍於代碼一線。
options.en: (B) Heavily use verbs like "Debugged," "Refactored," and "Analyzed" in your job descriptions to prove you are still active on the code frontline.

options.t: (C) 將職稱改為 "Engineering Manager" 以匹配你的年資，並強調架構設計能力。
options.en: (C) Change your job title to "Engineering Manager" to match your seniority and emphasize architectural design skills.

options.t: (D) 刪除早期的工作經歷，只保留最近 5 年的經驗，讓你看起來比較年輕。
options.en: (D) Remove early work experience and only keep the last 5 years to make you appear younger.

why.t: 此職缺的核心是「代碼評測」而非「團隊管理」。選項 (B) 通過具體的行動動詞（Action Verbs）向面試官發出訊號，表明你雖然資深，但仍然具備「找錯」與「優化」的實戰能力（Hands-on），這正是 RLHF 職位最看重的特質。選項 (A) 和 (C) 會強化「管理者」形象，反而可能讓面試官覺得你「太貴」或「不適合做細節審查」。
why.en: The core of this role is "code evaluation," not "team management." Option (B) signals to the interviewer through specific Action Verbs that despite your seniority, you still possess the hands-on ability to "find bugs" and "optimize," which is exactly what an RLHF role values. Options (A) and (C) reinforce a "manager" persona, which might make the interviewer feel you are "too expensive" or "unsuited for detailed review."

question.t: 根據策略建議，為了讓你的技能區塊（Core Skills）在 6 秒內抓住 Recruiter 的眼球，並直接對應 JD 的 AI 評測需求，你應該新增哪一個特定的技能分類？
question.en: According to the strategy, to make your Core Skills section catch the Recruiter's eye within 6 seconds and directly align with the JD's AI evaluation needs, which specific skill category should you add?

options.t: (A) Cloud & DevOps
options.en: (A) Cloud & DevOps

options.t: (B) AI & Code Quality
options.en: (B) AI & Code Quality

options.t: (C) Frontend Frameworks
options.en: (C) Frontend Frameworks

options.t: (D) Project Management
options.en: (D) Project Management

why.t: JD 的核心任務是評估 AI 生成的代碼品質。新增 "AI & Code Quality" 分類並列出如 *Generative AI Principles, RLHF Concepts, Automated Testing* 等關鍵字，能最直接地回應職缺需求。雖然 Cloud & DevOps 也是你的強項，但針對此職缺，它不是最優先的篩選關鍵。
why.en: The core task of the JD is evaluating the quality of AI-generated code. Adding an "AI & Code Quality" category with keywords like *Generative AI Principles, RLHF Concepts, Automated Testing* most directly addresses the role's requirements. While Cloud & DevOps is a strength of yours, it is not the primary screening criterion for this specific role.

question.t: 在 Hiveel 的經歷中，你原本寫道："Designed REST APIs... adopted TDD with JUnit5 + H2 to ensure reliability."
question.en: In your Hiveel experience, you originally wrote: "Designed REST APIs... adopted TDD with JUnit5 + H2 to ensure reliability."

question.t: 為了將這段經歷轉化為「代碼評測專家」的訊號，以下哪種改寫方式最具策略性？
question.en: To transform this experience into a signal of a "Code Evaluation Expert," which of the following rewrites is most strategic?

options.t: (A) "Built high-performance REST APIs using Spring Boot and optimized database queries for vehicle search engines."
options.en: (A) "Built high-performance REST APIs using Spring Boot and optimized database queries for vehicle search engines."

options.t: (B) "Implemented rigorous TDD workflows using JUnit5, ensuring 100% test coverage for critical algorithms and validating logic integrity."
options.en: (B) "Implemented rigorous TDD workflows using JUnit5, ensuring 100% test coverage for critical algorithms and validating logic integrity."

options.t: (C) "Collaborated with UI teams to design request flows and modeled relational schemas using EER diagrams."
options.en: (C) "Collaborated with UI teams to design request flows and modeled relational schemas using EER diagrams."

options.t: (D) "Managed the backend development lifecycle from design to deployment, ensuring timely delivery of features."
options.en: (D) "Managed the backend development lifecycle from design to deployment, ensuring timely delivery of features."

why.t: 選項 (B) 將重點從「開發功能」轉移到了「驗證品質」與「測試覆蓋率」。這直接對應了 JD 中的 "Validate algorithms" 與 "Review... for technical accuracy"。它展示了你具備嚴格的品質把關思維（Quality Gatekeeper），而不僅僅是一個功能開發者。
why.en: Option (B) shifts the focus from "developing features" to "validating quality" and "test coverage." This directly corresponds to "Validate algorithms" and "Review... for technical accuracy" in the JD. It demonstrates that you possess a rigorous Quality Gatekeeper mindset, rather than just being a feature developer.

question.t: JD 特別要求 "Excellent technical writing with attention to implementation detail" 以及 "Provide detailed feedback"。
question.en: The JD specifically asks for "Excellent technical writing with attention to implementation detail" and "Provide detailed feedback."

question.t: 你原本在 Innova 的履歷中寫道："Maintained [FDA 510K] Sharing List Product Area Design Specification"。為了更好地證明你的評測反饋能力，這句話應該如何優化？
question.en: You originally wrote in your Innova resume: "Maintained [FDA 510K] Sharing List Product Area Design Specification." To better demonstrate your evaluation feedback capability, how should this sentence be optimized?

options.t: (A) "Wrote high-level design documents for FDA compliance products."
options.en: (A) "Wrote high-level design documents for FDA compliance products."

options.t: (B) "Authored detailed technical specifications and provided structured feedback to engineering teams on implementation feasibility."
options.en: (B) "Authored detailed technical specifications and provided structured feedback to engineering teams on implementation feasibility."

options.t: (C) "Responsible for all documentation regarding the FDA 510K product line."
options.en: (C) "Responsible for all documentation regarding the FDA 510K product line."

options.t: (D) "Created user manuals and help guides for the Sharing List product."
options.en: (D) "Created user manuals and help guides for the Sharing List product."

why.t: 選項 (B) 加入了 "structured feedback" 和 "implementation feasibility" 這兩個關鍵概念，這正是 Code Evaluation 工作中「寫作」的主要目的——不僅是記錄，更是為了指導與修正。這直接回應了 JD 對於提供詳細反饋的要求。
why.en: Option (B) incorporates the key concepts of "structured feedback" and "implementation feasibility," which are the primary purposes of "writing" in a Code Evaluation role—not just recording, but guiding and correcting. This directly addresses the JD's requirement for providing detailed feedback.

question.t: JD 提到一項關鍵任務："Support model benchmarking to assess technical capabilities"。
question.en: The JD mentions a key task: "Support model benchmarking to assess technical capabilities."

question.t: 雖然你可能沒有直接訓練大模型的經驗，但你可以利用過往經歷中的哪一部分來證明你具備「基準測試（Benchmarking）」的潛力？
question.en: Although you may not have direct experience training large models, which part of your past experience can you leverage to demonstrate your potential for "Benchmarking"?

options.t: (A) 在 USTOSHOP.COM 實作 ElasticSearch 索引並優化搜尋查詢效能的經驗。
options.en: (A) Experience implementing ElasticSearch indexing and optimizing search query performance at USTOSHOP.COM.

options.t: (B) 在 Chunghwa Telecom 領導跨部門專案交付的經驗。
options.en: (B) Experience leading cross-functional project delivery at Chunghwa Telecom.

options.t: (C) 在 Innova Solutions 維護 GCP 雲端環境的經驗。
options.en: (C) Experience maintaining GCP cloud environments at Innova Solutions.

options.t: (D) 獲得 Google Professional Cloud Architect 認證的經歷。
options.en: (D) Experience obtaining the Google Professional Cloud Architect certification.

why.t: Benchmarking（基準測試）的核心在於「測量性能」與「比較結果」。選項 (A) 涉及 ElasticSearch 的效能優化與查詢調校，這需要對演算法效率進行評估與對比，其底層邏輯與評測 AI 模型的輸出品質與效能是高度相通的。這是將「傳統效能優化」轉譯為「AI 基準測試能力」的最佳切入點。
why.en: The core of Benchmarking lies in "measuring performance" and "comparing results." Option (A) involves performance optimization and query tuning for ElasticSearch, which requires evaluating and comparing algorithmic efficiency. The underlying logic is highly transferable to evaluating the output quality and performance of AI models. This is the best entry point to translate "traditional performance optimization" into "AI benchmarking capability."

question.t: JD 要求精通 Python, JavaScript, Java, C++。你的履歷在 Core Skills 中列出了 C++，但在最近的工作經歷（Innova, Hiveel）中較少提及。
question.en: The JD requires proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Java, and C++. Your resume lists C++ in Core Skills, but it is rarely mentioned in recent work experiences (Innova, Hiveel).

question.t: 為了加強你對 C++ 評測能力的說服力，根據策略，你應該如何在 Skills 區塊進行微調？
question.en: To strengthen the persuasiveness of your C++ evaluation capabilities, according to the strategy, how should you fine-tune the Skills section?

options.t: (A) 刪除 C++，因為最近沒用過，以免面試被問倒。
options.en: (A) Remove C++ because you haven't used it recently, to avoid being stumped in the interview.

options.t: (B) 僅列出 C++，並在面試時口頭解釋你以前在學校學過。
options.en: (B) Just list C++ and verbally explain during the interview that you learned it in school.

options.t: (C) 為 C++ 加上括號註解用途，例如："C++ (System-level Logic & Performance Optimization)"。
options.en: (C) Add a parenthetical note to C++ describing its usage, for example: "C++ (System-level Logic & Performance Optimization)."

options.t: (D) 將 C++ 移動到履歷的第一個技能位置，暗示它是你最強的語言。
options.en: (D) Move C++ to the first position in your skills list to imply it is your strongest language.

why.t: 選項 (C) 採用了「情境化（Contextualization）」的策略。即使近期工作未大量使用，透過標註 "System-level Logic" 或 "Performance Optimization"，你向面試官展示了你理解該語言的最佳應用場景。這對於 Code Evaluation 角色來說至關重要，因為你需要評估的是代碼是否符合該語言的特性與最佳實踐。
why.en: Option (C) adopts a "Contextualization" strategy. Even if not used heavily in recent work, by tagging it with "System-level Logic" or "Performance Optimization," you demonstrate to the interviewer that you understand the best application scenarios for the language. This is crucial for a Code Evaluation role, as you need to assess whether the code aligns with the language's characteristics and best practices.

question.t: 你的履歷中擁有 "Google Certified: Professional Cloud Architect" 證照。雖然這是一個加分項，但針對這份「代碼評測 (Code Evaluation)」職缺，若過度強調「架構設計」可能會產生什麼負面影響？又該如何正確定位此證照？
question.en: You hold the "Google Certified: Professional Cloud Architect" certification. While valuable, what is the potential downside of over-emphasizing "architecture design" for this specific "Code Evaluation" role, and how should you correctly position it?

options.t: (A) 可能會被視為資歷過高 (Overqualified) 且不願處理代碼細節；應將其定位為「具備驗證雲端原生代碼與安全性合規的能力」。
options.en: (A) You might be seen as overqualified and unwilling to handle code details; position it as "capability to validate cloud-native code and security compliance."

options.t: (B) 可能會讓面試官認為你不懂 AI；應將此證照移除，僅保留 Generative AI Leader 證照。
options.en: (B) It might imply you don't understand AI; remove this certification and only keep the Generative AI Leader certification.

options.t: (C) 可能會被認為薪資要求過高；應將其描述為「正在學習中」而非已取得。
options.en: (C) It might suggest your salary expectation is too high; describe it as "in progress" rather than obtained.

options.t: (D) 沒有負面影響，應盡量強調你設計過的大型系統，以證明你能勝任 Tech Lead 角色。
options.en: (D) No negative impact; emphasize the large-scale systems you designed to prove you can act as a Tech Lead.

why.t: 此職缺的核心是「動手評測代碼 (Hands-on Code Evaluation)」。過度強調高階架構設計可能會讓 Recruiter 誤以為你只對管理或規劃感興趣，而非執行細節任務。最佳策略是利用此證照證明你對「雲端環境下的代碼正確性與安全性」有權威性的判斷力。
why.en: The core of this role is "Hands-on Code Evaluation." Over-emphasizing high-level architecture might mislead recruiters into thinking you are only interested in management or planning, not execution. The best strategy is to use this cert to prove your authoritative judgment on "code correctness and security in cloud environments."

question.t: JD 中列出了一項具體職責："Organize content by topic, difficulty level, and programming language proficiency"。作為資深工程師，你該如何轉化過往的「指導 (Mentorship)」經驗來直接回應此需求？
question.en: The JD lists a specific responsibility: "Organize content by topic, difficulty level, and programming language proficiency." As a Senior Engineer, how should you translate your past "Mentorship" experience to directly address this requirement?

options.t: (A) "Mentored 5 junior engineers and conducted weekly code reviews."
options.en: (A) "Mentored 5 junior engineers and conducted weekly code reviews."

options.t: (B) "Created structured onboarding curriculums, categorizing technical tasks by complexity to accelerate team ramp-up."
options.en: (B) "Created structured onboarding curriculums, categorizing technical tasks by complexity to accelerate team ramp-up."

options.t: (C) "Managed sprint backlogs and assigned tasks based on developer availability."
options.en: (C) "Managed sprint backlogs and assigned tasks based on developer availability."

options.t: (D) "Led cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products on time."
options.en: (D) "Led cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software products on time."

why.t: 選項 (B) 使用了 "categorizing technical tasks by complexity"（按複雜度分類技術任務），這與 JD 要求的 "Organize content by... difficulty level" 高度對應。它展示了你具備「設計學習路徑」與「評估難度」的能力，而不僅僅是單純的人員指導。
why.en: Option (B) uses "categorizing technical tasks by complexity," which corresponds highly with the JD's request to "Organize content by... difficulty level." It demonstrates your ability to "design learning paths" and "assess difficulty," rather than just general mentorship.

question.t: JD 要求 "Refine technical prompts"。你在 Innova Solutions 的履歷中提到了 "leveraged AI-assisted development"。為了更有力地證明你具備 Prompt Engineering 的實戰能力，你應該如何改寫這段經歷？
question.en: The JD requires "Refine technical prompts." Your resume mentions "leveraged AI-assisted development" at Innova Solutions. To more strongly prove your practical Prompt Engineering skills, how should you rewrite this experience?

options.t: (A) "Used ChatGPT to generate boilerplate code, increasing coding speed by 30%."
options.en: (A) "Used ChatGPT to generate boilerplate code, increasing coding speed by 30%."

options.t: (B) "Integrated OpenAI API into the backend to power customer-facing chatbots."
options.en: (B) "Integrated OpenAI API into the backend to power customer-facing chatbots."

options.t: (C) "Iteratively refined system prompts and context constraints to minimize hallucinations in AI-generated SQL queries."
options.en: (C) "Iteratively refined system prompts and context constraints to minimize hallucinations in AI-generated SQL queries."

options.t: (D) "Followed AI trends and completed prompt engineering courses on Coursera."
options.en: (D) "Followed AI trends and completed prompt engineering courses on Coursera."

why.t: 選項 (C) 具體描述了「優化 Prompt」的過程（Refined system prompts）與目的（Minimize hallucinations），這直接證明了你懂得如何「調教」AI 模型以產出高品質代碼，完全命中 JD 的核心需求。選項 (A) 僅強調使用者層面的「速度」，缺乏技術深度。
why.en: Option (C) specifically describes the process (Refined system prompts) and goal (Minimize hallucinations) of optimizing prompts. This directly proves you know how to "tune" AI models to produce high-quality code, hitting the JD's core requirement perfectly. Option (A) only emphasizes user-level "speed" and lacks technical depth.

question.t: 在一般的軟體開發職缺中，我們常強調「開發速度 (Velocity)」或「部署頻率」。但在針對這份 AI 評測 (RLHF) 職缺優化履歷時，你應該將 Code Review 的成效指標調整為下列何者，最能引起雇主共鳴？
question.en: In general software development roles, we often emphasize "Velocity" or "Deployment Frequency." However, when tailoring your resume for this AI Evaluation (RLHF) role, which of the following success metrics for Code Review would resonate most with the employer?

options.t: (A) "Reduced code review turnaround time by 50% to accelerate feature delivery."
options.en: (A) "Reduced code review turnaround time by 50% to accelerate feature delivery."

options.t: (B) "Ensured 100% syntactic correctness and identified logic flaws in edge cases for critical algorithms."
options.en: (B) "Ensured 100% syntactic correctness and identified logic flaws in edge cases for critical algorithms."

options.t: (C) "Implemented automated deployment pipelines to support daily releases."
options.en: (C) "Implemented automated deployment pipelines to support daily releases."

options.t: (D) "Managed a team of 10 developers to meet quarterly product roadmaps."
options.en: (D) "Managed a team of 10 developers to meet quarterly product roadmaps."

why.t: AI 訓練與評測公司最看重的是「資料品質」與「正確性」。選項 (B) 強調了 "Syntactic correctness"（語法正確性）與 "Edge cases"（邊界情況），這正是 RLHF 工作中用來訓練模型避免錯誤的關鍵。速度（選項 A）雖然重要，但在這個脈絡下，準確度 (Accuracy) 才是王道。
why.en: AI training and evaluation companies prioritize "data quality" and "correctness." Option (B) highlights "Syntactic correctness" and "Edge cases," which are critical for training models to avoid errors in RLHF work. While speed (Option A) is important, in this context, Accuracy is king.
